articles.title: China-Russia-US summit: Injecting stability into a turbulent world
articles.titleCn: 中俄美峰会：为动荡世界注入稳定性

Many Western commentators have rushed to frame this summit as a reprise of the Cold War "big triangle" or a new Yalta-style arrangement. Such {{21}} do not hold. The Yalta system was premised on the division of spheres of influence by power, centered on {{22}} leverage games.
paragraphs.cn: 各方同意就降低核风险和防止核扩散保持对话，表明它们认识到一条共同底线：竞争绝不能越过和平的红线。尽管声明并未消除三国之间根深蒂固的分歧，但它为未来的危机沟通确立了参照基准。许多西方评论人士急于将此次峰会解读为冷战“大三角”的重演或新雅尔塔式安排。此类类比并不成立。雅尔塔体系以大国按实力划分势力范围为前提，以对抗性杠杆博弈为核心。

paragraphs.en: The current trilateral interaction, by contrast, is essentially about strategic communication and coordination rather than traditional power politics. While advancing its comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination for the new era with Russia, China has also worked to maintain stable relations with the United States. It does not trade one bilateral relationship for another, nor does it allow any single bilateral relationship to hold its overall foreign policy hostage. This is not a return to power politics. Rather, it is an exploration of new paths for major countries to engage constructively in an era when no single country can unilaterally shape the global order.
paragraphs.cn: 相比之下，当前的三边互动本质上是战略沟通与协调，而非传统强权政治。中国在推进与俄罗斯新时代全面战略协作伙伴关系的同时，也努力保持与美国的稳定关系。它不以一种双边关系换取另一种双边关系，也不允许任何单一双边关系绑架其整体外交政策。这不是向强权政治的回归，而是在任何单一国家都无法单方面塑造全球秩序的时代，对大国建设性交往新路径的探索。

paragraphs.en:
From the perspective of global governance, China's approach is aimed at maintaining international strategic balance and preventing a {{23}} of bloc confrontation. The Global South countries are watching closely. What developing nations fear most is not divergences among major countries, but the {{24}} of such divergences into confrontation that forces them to take sides. Establishing predictable and stable communication mechanisms among China, Russia and the United States can {{25}} the risk of bloc-based division and create greater space for multilateral cooperation on global issues such as climate change, AI governance, public health and regional hotspots. It can also lay an important practical foundation for moving beyond outdated patterns of confrontation and building a new and more {{26}} model of globalization
Sound major-country relations hinge on strategic resolve and the shared responsibility to uphold peace despite differences.
paragraphs.cn: 从全球治理的角度看，中国的做法旨在维护国际战略平衡，防止集团对抗死灰复燃。全球南方国家正在密切关注。发展中国家最担心的不是大国之间的分歧，而是这种分歧升级为对抗并迫使它们选边站队。在中俄美之间建立可预测、稳定的沟通机制，可以降低集团分裂的风险，为气候变化、人工智能治理、公共卫生和地区热点等全球议题上的多边合作创造更大空间。它也能为超越过时的对抗模式、构建更具包容性的新型全球化模式奠定重要的实践基础。稳健的大国关系取决于战略决心以及尽管存在分歧仍共同维护和平的责任担当。

paragraphs.en: The Shenzhen summit has not built an entirely new international order overnight. Its more pragmatic value lies in opening regular working-level communication channels between three nations that shape the global landscape of this century. With these channels now in place, the crucial task ahead is to keep them open and make sincere use of dialogue mechanisms, allowing the logic of coordination to prevail over the logic of confrontation. This step forward, driven by China, confirms a long-held judgment of Beijing: in a multipolar world, dialogue rather than division is the sustainable option, and a viable path to meet the international community's expectations for peace and stability.
paragraphs.cn: 深圳峰会并未在一夜之间建立起全新的国际秩序。其更务实的价值在于，为塑造本世纪全球格局的三个国家开辟了常态化的工作层沟通渠道。渠道既已建立，今后的关键任务是保持其畅通，真诚运用对话机制，让协调逻辑战胜对抗逻辑。这一由中国推动的进展，印证了北京长期以来的判断：在多极世界中，对话而非分裂才是可持续的选择，也是满足国际社会对和平与稳定期待的可行路径。

articles.fullText:
Editor's Note: Zheng Changzhong is a professor at the School of International Relations and Public Affairs, Fudan University. The article reflects the author's opinions and does not necessarily represent the views of CGTN.
On November 19, 2026, the leaders of China, Russia and the United States held their first face-to-face meeting in Shenzhen and issued a joint declaration focusing on peace. The agenda covered key issues including UN reform, energy stability, reducing nuclear risks and preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons, and the inviolability of state immunity.
Initiated by China, this summit carries significance beyond the specific consensus laid out in the declaration itself. It stands as a landmark practice for major-country interactions in an era of multipolarity.
The post-Cold War era has come to an end. Yet the transition toward a multipolar order is fraught with uncertainties. Strategic competition among major countries continues to intensify, mutual strategic trust is eroding, and crisis management mechanisms are under growing strain. Against this backdrop, the fact that three countries with global influence have sat down for direct dialogue is itself an important signal of restraint and rationality. As Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning noted, the three countries bear significant responsibilities in addressing global challenges and advancing world peace and stability.
The success of this dialogue should not be measured by whether the parties can reach an ambitious package of agreements in a single step, but by whether major countries can replace reckless confrontation with dialogue and jointly uphold the bottom line of global stability.
China's push for this summit is rooted in its consistent independent foreign policy of peace and its commitment to the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation. As the host, China has no intention of forming an exclusive bloc, nor does it seek to act as an arbitrator between the other two parties. Rather, it clearly recognizes that the absence of stable and direct communication channels between major countries itself constitutes a major security risk.
By proactively creating opportunities for dialogue and providing a platform for strategic communication, China has helped bring together major countries with vastly different positions and interests, enabling them to face one another directly, exchange views candidly and manage their differences. This represents a constructive diplomatic undertaking grounded in strategic patience rather than coercive bargaining.
The outcomes of the summit reflect this logic. The joint declaration forged consensus on nuclear risk control, non-proliferation of nuclear weapons, UN reform, energy security and preventing the abuse of international judicial mechanisms. A breakdown of major-country coordination in these areas could trigger global risks.
The parties' agreement to maintain dialogue on reducing nuclear risks and preventing nuclear proliferation signals their recognition of a shared bottom line: competition must never cross the red line of peace. While the declaration has not erased the deep-rooted differences among the three countries, it has established a reference benchmark for future crisis communication.
Many Western commentators have rushed to frame this summit as a reprise of the Cold War "big triangle" or a new Yalta-style arrangement. Such analogies do not hold. The Yalta system was premised on the division of spheres of influence by power, centered on adversarial leverage games. The current trilateral interaction, by contrast, is essentially about strategic communication and coordination rather than traditional power politics. While advancing its comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination for the new era with Russia, China has also worked to maintain stable relations with the United States. It does not trade one bilateral relationship for another, nor does it allow any single bilateral relationship to hold its overall foreign policy hostage. This is not a return to power politics. Rather, it is an exploration of new paths for major countries to engage constructively in an era when no single country can unilaterally shape the global order.
From the perspective of global governance, China's approach is aimed at maintaining international strategic balance and preventing a resurgence of bloc confrontation. The Global South countries are watching closely. What developing nations fear most is not divergences among major countries, but the escalation of such divergences into confrontation that forces them to take sides.
Establishing predictable and stable communication mechanisms among China, Russia and the United States can mitigate the risk of bloc-based division and create greater space for multilateral cooperation on global issues such as climate change, AI governance, public health and regional hotspots. It can also lay an important practical foundation for moving beyond outdated patterns of confrontation and building a new and more inclusive model of globalization
Sound major-country relations hinge on strategic resolve and the shared responsibility to uphold peace despite differences. The Shenzhen summit has not built an entirely new international order overnight. Its more pragmatic value lies in opening regular working-level communication channels between three nations that shape the global landscape of this century. With these channels now in place, the crucial task ahead is to keep them open and make sincere use of dialogue mechanisms, allowing the logic of coordination to prevail over the logic of confrontation.
This step forward, driven by China, confirms a long-held judgment of Beijing: in a multipolar world, dialogue rather than division is the sustainable option, and a viable path to meet the international community's expectations for peace and stability.

articles.title: Comicomment: APEC Shenzhen meeting injects fresh momentum into Asia-Pacific cooperation
articles.titleCn: 漫画评论：APEC深圳会议为亚太合作注入新动力
articles.summary: The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting was held in Shenzhen on November 18-19. Following Shanghai and Beijing, Shenzhen became the third Chinese city to host an APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting. Its openness, connectivity and innovation-driven dynamism reflect the resilience and vitality of Asia-Pacific cooperation.
articles.summaryCn: 2026年APEC深圳会议通过深化贸易联通、绿色转型和数字合作，为亚太地区合作注入新动力，彰显开放创新的亚太共同体精神。

paragraphs.en: The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting was held in Shenzhen on November 18-19. Following Shanghai and Beijing, Shenzhen became the third Chinese city to host an APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting. Its openness, {{2}} and innovation-driven dynamism reflect the {{0}} and {{1}} of Asia-Pacific cooperation. APEC’s economic and trade connectivity has continued to deepen. In the first ten months of 2026, China’s trade in goods with other APEC economies reached 27.08 trillion yuan, up 25.4 percent year on year.
paragraphs.cn: 第33届APEC经济领导人会议于11月18日至19日在深圳举行。继上海和北京之后，深圳成为第三个主办APEC经济领导人会议的中国城市。其开放、联通和创新驱动的活力反映了亚太合作的韧性和生命力。APEC的经贸联通持续深化。2026年前十个月，中国与其他APEC经济体的货物贸易额达到27.08万亿元人民币，同比增长25.4%。

paragraphs.en: Since 2026, the Port of Shenzhen has opened 30 new shipping routes passing through APEC economies, further {{3}} the Asia-Pacific shipping network. In July, Port of Shenzhen signed the APEC Economies Port Friendship Cooperation Agreement with 16 ports across 10 APEC economies. Denser routes and better-connected ports have made the gains of Asia-Pacific cooperation increasingly {{4}}. Green {{5}} in 2026 has moved faster from vision to rules and action. The 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting in Beijing in September proposed and {{6}} defined the “Asia-Pacific Energy Community” for the first time.
paragraphs.cn: 自2026年以来，深圳港新开通了30条途经APEC经济体的航线，进一步加密了亚太航运网络。7月，深圳港与10个APEC经济体的16个港口签署了《APEC经济体港口友好合作协定》。更密集的航线和更紧密连接的港口使亚太合作的成果日益切实可感。2026年绿色转型从愿景更快地转向规则和行动。9月在北京举行的第16届APEC能源部长会议首次提出并系统定义了“亚太能源共同体”。

paragraphs.en: The Shenzhen Initiative, adopted at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit 2026 in November, further called for {{7}} the establishment of a green trade rules {{8}}, promoting the shift toward zero- and low-carbon mobility, and {{9}} stable, {{10}} and smooth flows in green supply chains—{{11}} green rules from the energy production end to the trade and supply chain end. The APEC meetings themselves became a {{12}} of green transition: key venues, transport hubs and reception facilities ran on 100 percent green electricity. Asia-Pacific green transition is thus acquiring a {{13}} pace of {{14}} in 2026. The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting was held in Shenzhen on November 18-19. Following Shanghai and Beijing, Shenzhen became the third Chinese city to host an APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting. Its openness, connectivity and innovation-driven dynamism reflect the resilience and vitality of Asia-Pacific cooperation.
APEC’s economic and trade connectivity has continued to deepen. In the first ten months of 2026, China’s trade in goods with other APEC economies reached 27.08 trillion yuan, up 25.4 percent year on year. Since 2026, the Port of Shenzhen has opened 30 new shipping routes passing through APEC economies, further densifying the Asia-Pacific shipping network. In July, Port of Shenzhen signed the APEC Economies Port Friendship Cooperation Agreement with 16 ports across 10 APEC economies. Denser routes and better-connected ports have made the gains of Asia-Pacific cooperation increasingly tangible.
Green transition in 2026 has moved faster from vision to rules and action. The 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting in Beijing in September proposed and systematically defined the “Asia-Pacific Energy Community” for the first time. The Shenzhen Initiative, adopted at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit 2026 in November, further called for accelerating the establishment of a green trade rules framework, promoting the shift toward zero- and low-carbon mobility, and safeguarding stable, resilient and smooth flows in green supply chains—extending green rules from the energy production end to the trade and supply chain end. The APEC meetings themselves became a demonstration of green transition: key venues, transport hubs and reception facilities ran on 100 percent green electricity. Asia-Pacific green transition is thus acquiring a verifiable pace of implementation in 2026.
Frontier fields such as new energy and artificial intelligence have become key drivers of global development and important agenda items for Asia-Pacific cooperation. The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit 2026 “building an open and inclusive AI innovation ecosystem” as one of its seven sub-themes, grounding technological cooperation in the scale of inclusive sharing. Digital and smart economic and trade cooperation has become the area with the broadest consensus and strongest cooperative atmosphere among APEC members. At the APEC CEO Summit, Chinese and foreign participants held in-depth exchanges on trade digitalization, AI, digital services and other topics, exploring ways to accelerate the application of innovations and deeper industrial integration.
From shipping routes and clean energy to industrial collaboration and smart technologies, cooperation across the Asia-Pacific is advancing through concrete actions and shared achievements.
APEC is not a game for a select few economies to lead. It is a shared endeavor in which all members contribute to building capacity and fostering a stronger regional ecosystem. Through openness, innovation and cooperation, the Asia-Pacific community continues to move forward, strengthened by closer connections and shared opportunities.

articles.title: Xi's speech at APEC CEO Summit resonates with global business leaders
articles.titleCn: 习近平在APEC工商领导人峰会的讲话引发全球商界领袖共鸣
articles.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping's keynote speech at the opening ceremony of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit 2026 in Shenzhen on Wednesday has drawn positive responses from international business leaders, who voiced support for his vision of openness, free trade and regional cooperation.
articles.summaryCn: 习近平在2026年深圳APEC工商领导人峰会开幕式上的主旨演讲强调开放、自由贸易和区域合作，获得国际商界领袖的积极回应，他们对中国市场潜力、创新与绿色发展以及区域互联互通表示支持和信心。

paragraphs.en: Chinese President Xi Jinping's {{0}} speech at the opening ceremony of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit 2026 in Shenzhen on Wednesday has drawn positive responses from international business leaders, who voiced support for his vision of openness, free trade and regional cooperation. Annette Gregg, CEO of the World Trade Centers Association, said Xi's call for free and open trade and investment was encouraging. She noted that China's support for free and fair trade and a rules-based {{3}} trading system would help promote shared {{2}}. Sean Stein, president of the US-China Business Council, said Xi's message resonated with business leaders attending the summit, particularly his clear support for open and fair trade, free trade and regional investment. He added that the business community expected China to continue playing a leading role. Olivier Desmarais, president of the Canada China Business Council, said Xi's emphasis on further opening up and upholding the rules-based international economic order could help bring stability amid global {{4}}.
paragraphs.cn: 中国国家主席习近平周三在深圳举行的2026年亚太经合组织（APEC）工商领导人峰会开幕式上发表主旨演讲，引发国际商界领袖的积极回应，他们表达了对习近平关于开放、自由贸易和区域合作愿景的支持。世界贸易中心协会首席执行官安妮特·格雷格表示，习近平对自由开放贸易和投资的呼吁令人鼓舞。她指出，中国对自由公平贸易和基于规则的多边贸易体系的支持将有助于促进共同繁荣。美中贸易全国委员会主席肖恩·斯坦表示，习近平的信息引起了与会商界领袖的共鸣，尤其是他对开放公平贸易、自由贸易和区域投资的明确支持。他补充说，商界期待中国继续发挥引领作用。加中贸易理事会主席奥利维尔·德马雷表示，习近平强调进一步开放和维护基于规则的国际经济秩序，有助于在全球不确定性中带来稳定。

paragraphs.en: Xi's remarks on China's market potential also strengthened foreign companies' confidence in the country. Saravoot Yoovidhya, CEO of Thai beverage company TCP Group, said Xi's emphasis on the importance of openness has left a strong impression on him. He said that China's large middle-income population and {{5}} investment and consumption potential further {{6}} the company's confidence in expanding its investment and deepening its presence in the Chinese market. Business leaders also highlighted China's progress in {{7}} and green development. Benjamin Faes, CEO of British company RWS Group, praised China's {{8}} in areas ranging from new energy vehicles and hardware technology to software and large AI models, saying the country's development offered valuable {{9}}. Jennifer Jordan-Saifi, CEO of Sustainable Markets Initiative (SMI), said China had demonstrated through {{10}} actions that economic growth and environmental protection could go hand in hand, highlighting its role in advancing sustainable development through green {{11}}.
paragraphs.cn: 习近平关于中国市场潜力的讲话也增强了外国企业对中国市场的信心。泰国饮料公司TCP集团首席执行官萨拉武·尤维德亚表示，习近平对开放重要性的强调给他留下了深刻印象。他说，中国庞大的中等收入人口以及巨大的投资和消费潜力进一步增强了该公司扩大投资、深化在中国市场存在的信心。商界领袖还强调了中国在创新和绿色发展方面的进展。英国RWS集团首席执行官本杰明·法斯称赞中国在新能源汽车、硬件技术以及软件和大规模人工智能模型等领域取得的成就，称中国的发展提供了宝贵的启示。可持续市场倡议（SMI）首席执行官詹妮弗·乔丹-赛菲表示，中国通过具体行动表明经济增长和环境保护可以齐头并进，凸显了其在通过绿色转型推进可持续发展方面的作用。

paragraphs.en: Regional {{12}} and cooperation were other key themes welcomed by business leaders. Ryan McInerney, CEO of Visa, said building an Asia-Pacific community offered significant opportunities for the business sector, which remained committed to investing in and contributing to the process. BHP's Chief Development Officer Catherine Raw expressed support for stronger regional connectivity, particularly in trade {{13}}, digital connectivity and green transition. She stressed the importance of connected markets and more open, {{14}} trade rules to support future growth and investment. Kevin Maurice, president of New Zealand's Atrax Group, expressed {{15}} about APEC's future and China's role in the organization. He said continued exchanges and mutual respect among economies would help strengthen regional economic ties.
paragraphs.cn: 区域互联互通与合作是商界领袖欢迎的其他关键主题。Visa首席执行官瑞安·麦金纳尼表示，建设亚太共同体为商业部门提供了重大机遇，商业部门仍致力于投资并推动这一进程。必和必拓首席发展官凯瑟琳·罗表示支持加强区域互联互通，特别是在贸易便利化、数字互联互通和绿色转型方面。她强调互联市场以及更加开放、透明的贸易规则对支持未来增长和投资的重要性。新西兰Atrax集团总裁凯文·莫里斯对APEC的未来和中国在该组织中的作用表示乐观。他说，各经济体之间持续交流和相互尊重将有助于加强区域经济联系。

articles.fullText:
Chinese President Xi Jinping's keynote speech at the opening ceremony of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit 2026 in Shenzhen on Wednesday has drawn positive responses from international business leaders, who voiced support for his vision of openness, free trade and regional cooperation.
Annette Gregg, CEO of the World Trade Centers Association, said Xi's call for free and open trade and investment was encouraging. She noted that China's support for free and fair trade and a rules-based multilateral trading system would help promote shared prosperity.
Sean Stein, president of the US-China Business Council, said Xi's message resonated with business leaders attending the summit, particularly his clear support for open and fair trade, free trade and regional investment. He added that the business community expected China to continue playing a leading role.
Olivier Desmarais, president of the Canada China Business Council, said Xi's emphasis on further opening up and upholding the rules-based international economic order could help bring stability amid global uncertainty.
Xi's remarks on China's market potential also strengthened foreign companies' confidence in the country. Saravoot Yoovidhya, CEO of Thai beverage company TCP Group, said Xi's emphasis on the importance of openness has left a strong impression on him. He said that China's large middle-income population and substantial investment and consumption potential further reinforced the company's confidence in expanding its investment and deepening its presence in the Chinese market.
Business leaders also highlighted China's progress in innovation and green development. Benjamin Faes, CEO of British company RWS Group, praised China's achievements in areas ranging from new energy vehicles and hardware technology to software and large AI models, saying the country's development offered valuable inspiration.
Jennifer Jordan-Saifi, CEO of Sustainable Markets Initiative (SMI), said China had demonstrated through concrete actions that economic growth and environmental protection could go hand in hand, highlighting its role in advancing sustainable development through green transition.
Regional connectivity and cooperation were other key themes welcomed by business leaders. Ryan McInerney, CEO of Visa, said building an Asia-Pacific community offered significant opportunities for the business sector, which remained committed to investing in and contributing to the process.
BHP's Chief Development Officer Catherine Raw expressed support for stronger regional connectivity, particularly in trade facilitation, digital connectivity and green transition. She stressed the importance of connected markets and more open, transparent trade rules to support future growth and investment.
Kevin Maurice, president of New Zealand's Atrax Group, expressed optimism about APEC's future and China's role in the organization. He said continued exchanges and mutual respect among economies would help strengthen regional economic ties.

articles.fullText:
Anthropic announced on Monday that it would release updated versions of two of its most powerful artificial intelligence (AI) models as the company prepares for a highly anticipated IPO this month.
The new models, Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, can perform up to 30% faster than previous versions, particularly on complex tasks such as coding, while costing 20% less, the company said.
Both are built on the same underlying model. Fable 5.2 has safeguards that block most cybersecurity and biology tasks, which lets Anthropic offer it to all users.
Mythos 5.2 has fewer of those restrictions and is available only to vetted organizations working in cybersecurity or biomedical research.
The first versions of Fable and Mythos were released under a cloud of controversy.
Both models were pulled days after their June launch, when the US Commerce Department, citing national security concerns, ordered Anthropic to bar access by foreign nationals. The controls were lifted weeks later.
The latest versions come as Anthropic is aiming to hold its initial public offering the week of November 16, when it is expected to raise up to $100 billion, which would make it the largest IPO on record.
The San Francisco-based lab's Wall Street debut is expected to fetch a valuation exceeding $1 trillion, though estimates have fallen in recent weeks from a high of $2 trillion.
The stock market debut is being seen as a gauge of how long the AI spending boom lifting the US economy can last.
Growth has been staggering at the company. Anthropic's revenue reached $17 billion in the third quarter, up from just $1.4 billion a year earlier, a securities filing showed earlier this month.
Sales growth slowed from previous quarters, however, amid fierce competition from ChatGPT-maker OpenAI and cheaper models, many of them from China.
Anthropic also posted an operating loss of $567 million in the third quarter as it paid more for short-term computing capacity.
The company’s valuation has also been weighed down by a broader market pullback after a string of quarterly earnings reports spooked investors.
These raised concerned about the hundreds of billions of dollars that US tech giants are spending on AI.
Democrats also regained control of Congress in the US midterms, raising investor concerns about a potential regulatory crackdown on the tech industry, including against data center buildouts.
Ballot measures restricting data center construction could hamper the growth plans of AI developers such as Anthropic, as well as rivals including OpenAI, Meta, Microsoft and Google.

articles.fullText:
Ghanaian President John Dramani Mahama delivers a speech during the inauguration of vaccine research and development laboratories and a human identification facility at the Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research, University of Ghana, Legon, on November 18, 2026. /Ministry of Health, Ghana
Ghana commissioned new vaccine research and development facilities at the Noguchi Memorial Institute for Medical Research in Accra on Thursday as part of government efforts to move the country towards greater healthcare self-sufficiency.
Launched by President John Dramani Mahama, the facilities are intended to strengthen the country's health security, scientific research and forensic capabilities by expanding domestic capacity for vaccine development and DNA testing.
The vaccine research facilities include mRNA and protein expression laboratories, while the DNA laboratory will enable human identification tests to be conducted in Ghana rather than relying on overseas facilities.
The project follows the August 6, 2025, military helicopter crash that killed eight prominent Ghanaians. DNA samples had to be sent to South Africa for identification, exposing gaps in the country's capacity to handle such emergencies.
Speaking at the inauguration, Mahama said the new facilities would help provide families with timely answers during national tragedies. He also said the vaccine laboratories would give Ghanaian scientists the tools to develop vaccines locally.
"This facility will help us provide families with answers in times of tragedy, and the vaccine research laboratories will also give our scientists the means to develop our own vaccines here in Ghana," President Mahama said.
"By commissioning this facilities today, we affirm our collective determination to build a Ghana that can safeguard its health security, advance scientific innovation and chart its own course towards prosperity," he added.
The inauguration marks an expansion of Ghana's research and forensic infrastructure, with the facilities expected to support local scientific work and reduce dependence on external laboratories for specialized testing.
articles.fullTextCn:
加纳总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马于2026年11月18日在加纳大学莱贡校区的诺古奇纪念医学研究所出席疫苗研发实验室和人类身份鉴定设施的揭幕仪式并发表讲话。/加纳卫生部

加纳于周四在阿克拉的诺古奇纪念医学研究所启用新的疫苗研发设施，这是政府推动国家迈向更高医疗自给自足水平努力的一部分。这些设施由总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马启动，旨在通过扩大国内疫苗开发和DNA检测能力，加强该国的健康安全、科学研究和法医鉴定能力。疫苗研究设施包括mRNA和蛋白质表达实验室，而DNA实验室将使人类身份鉴定检测能够在加纳境内进行，而无需依赖海外设施。该项目是在2025年8月6日造成八名加纳知名人士遇难的军用直升机坠毁事件之后推出的。

DNA样本此前不得不送往南非进行身份鉴定，暴露出该国在处理此类紧急事件方面能力的不足。马哈马在揭幕仪式上表示，新设施将有助于在国家悲剧期间为家属及时提供答案。他还表示，疫苗实验室将为加纳科学家提供在本土开发疫苗的工具。“这一设施将帮助我们在悲剧发生时给家属一个交代，疫苗研究实验室也将为我们自己的科学家提供在加纳开发我们自己的疫苗的手段，”马哈马总统说。“通过今天启用这些设施，我们申明我们的共同决心，要建设一个能够保障自身健康安全、推进科学创新并自主开辟繁荣之路的加纳，”他补充道。

此次揭幕标志着加纳研究和法医基础设施的扩展，这些设施预计将支持本地科学工作，并减少专业检测对外部实验室的依赖。
